**Team — hero — Content**

fields.label: Headline
fields.name: brg_team_hero_heading
fields.instructions: The hero display headline. Approved editable by Sean 2026-08-13. LENGTH IS A HINT, NOT A LIMIT — under ~50 characters keeps it to 3 lines at 1440, but character count is only a proxy because WORD length drives the break: careers-hero renders 4 lines at 42 characters where community-hero renders 3 at 43, same rule and same width. 4 lines is the practical ceiling; at ~70 characters the headline is 5 lines and consumes the whole fold, pushing the next section off-screen. Measured, not guessed. The hero doodles were pinned to the padding band first (b324b35) so a longer headline can no longer drag one into the type — before that fix the top mark fell 43px between a 3-line and a 5-line headline and ended up level with the first line. This one is far under the budget, so it has the most room of the four.
